notes: Narrative of al-Ma'mun and al-Rida's accession: the Imam speaks and acts inside the scene; whether he is a source or only in the scene is a ruling case (rule 11)
Three routes (Yasir; Rayyan via «قال علي بن إبراهيم وحدثني»; the father via «وحدثني أبي») with their transmitters named in order; «وكان من رجال الحسن بن سهل» is a description, not a name
«كل هؤلاء حدثوا» is the compiler's summary of the three routes, not a shared tail
